title: Audit — 8-Stage Vulnerability Discovery Agent Based on Cloudflare Glasswing
description: From-scratch reimplementation of Cloudflare's Project Glasswing pipeline. 8 narrow agents working in parallel: Recon, Hunt, Disprove, Reachability trace, Feedback loop. Uses Claude Code Agent SDK. By evilsocket (bettercap creator). MIT licensed.

title: InsForge — All-in-One Backend for Agentic Coding
description: Open-source backend platform: databases, auth, storage, edge functions, AI gateway via single MCP server/CLI

title: AIO Sandbox — All-in-One Container for AI Agents
description: Browser+Shell+Filesystem+VSCode+Jupyter+MCP in single Docker container. Isolated agent execution.

title: GitNexus — Zero-Server Code Intelligence Engine for AI Agents (39.8K Stars)
description: Client-side knowledge graph that indexes codebases into dependency/call-chain/execution-flow graphs. Exposes via MCP so Cursor, Claude Code, Codex get architectural context and stop shipping blind edits. Runs entirely in browser.

title: Orca — Next-Gen ADE for Parallel Agent Fleets (3.1K Stars)
description: Agent Development Environment that runs any coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Cursor) in parallel fleets with one subscription. Desktop and mobile apps.

title: Sigil — AI Security Posture Management for Developer Machines
description: Host-side agent that watches files controlling what AI coding agents can do: hooks, permissions, MCP allowlists, sandbox flags. Scores dangerous configurations and ships events to SIEM. Rust. Monitors Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI.

title: Adrian — Runtime Security Monitoring for AI Agents (71 Stars)
description: Catches malicious tool use, prompt injection, and policy drift in real-time. Runtime security layer for autonomous agents. Python.

title: JanuScope — Local-First MCP Policy Proxy (15 Stars)
description: Tool-block, SQL-mutation gate, PII redact, audit, rate-limit, OpenTelemetry, vault secrets. TypeScript MCP policy proxy that sits between agents and MCP servers.

title: MCPGuard — CLI Security Checks for MCP Tools Before Agent Calls
description: Validates schema quality, response integrity, and security posture of MCP tools before AI agents call them. Python CLI.
